changelog:
- Initial release of the "paywalls" skill focused on optimizing in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, and feature gates.
- Provides proven frameworks and best practices for converting free users to paid at key product moments.
- Includes detailed guidelines for timing, paywall design, copywriting, and user journey considerations.
- Summarizes anti-patterns to avoid and offers actionable checklists and question prompts.
- Outlines A/B testing ideas and core metrics for ongoing paywall optimization.
- Clearly distinguishes in-product paywalls from public pricing pages (handled by the CRO skill).
summary: When the user wants to create or optimize in-app paywalls, upgrade screens, upsell modals, or feature gates. Also use when the user mentions "paywall," "upgrade screen," "upgrade modal," "upsell," "feature gate," "convert free to paid," "freemium conversion," "trial expiration screen," "limit reached screen," "plan upgrade prompt," "in-app pricing," "free users won't upgrade," "trial to paid conversion," or "how do I get users to pay." Use this for any in-product moment where you're asking users to upgrade. Distinct from public pricing pages (see cro) — this focuses on in-product upgrade moments where the user has already experienced value. For pricing decisions, see pricing.
